title: Full-suite audit: discount boundary, default jurisdiction, and reconciliation sign
instruction: Several ledger tests are failing. Fix all of them. One bug makes orders exactly at a discount threshold miss the discount; one makes the default tax jurisdiction tax-free; and one makes refunds and fees increase the reconciled balance instead of reducing it. Read the relevant modules before editing. Do not change the tests. Run the full tests/ suite until everything passes.

ground_truth.why_drift: Two of the three bugs share a file (pricing) but are unrelated; the agent fixes one, moves to reconciliation, then must return -- the pricing context read early is stale by the time reconciliation is done.
